name: FormEmpire
author: dieer

sections.description:
FormEmpire helps you get more quote requests and orders from your website with online forms: quote requests with an expected price range and itemised PDF quotes, orders with price calculation, a booking calendar, file uploads, e-signature, and connections to Make, Zapier, n8n, Google Sheets, MailerLite, SalesAutopilot and Mailchimp. The interface and the ready-made forms are in Hungarian.

This plugin places your FormEmpire forms in WordPress:

  • Block – “FormEmpire form” in the block editor: inline, or a button that opens the form in a popup or side panel.
  • Shortcode – [formempire id="FORMID"] anywhere, including page builders.
  • Floating button – a site-wide button whose label, colour and position you set in FormEmpire.
  • WooCommerce – a “Request a quote” button on product pages; the form gets the product name, SKU, category, price and link, and the logged-in customer’s name, e-mail and phone. Show it on every product, only on products that cannot be bought, or only when out of stock. A survey on the order-received page with the order data. Classic and block themes alike.

The forms themselves live at formempire.hu; submissions are handled there. A FormEmpire account is required (free plan available).

Third-party service

This plugin embeds forms from FormEmpire (https://formempire.hu), operated by the plugin author. Pages that contain a FormEmpire form, button or the floating button load https://formempire.hu/embed.js and show the form in an iframe from https://formempire.hu. Data typed into a form is sent to FormEmpire. If you set an API key, this site’s server calls https://formempire.hu/api/v1 to list your forms by name; the key is stored in this site’s options and never sent to the browser.

Terms: https://formempire.hu/aszf · Privacy: https://formempire.hu/adatkezeles
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Build a form at formempire.hu and copy its link (https://formempire.hu/f/…).
  3. Add the “FormEmpire form” block to a page and paste the link, or use [formempire id="…"].
  4. Optional: Settings → FormEmpire for the floating button, the WooCommerce quote button and an API key.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid FormEmpire plan?

No. The free plan works with this plugin, up to 50 submissions a month. File uploads and the integrations are paid features of FormEmpire.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi or other page builders?

Yes, use the shortcode [formempire id="FORMID"] in any text/HTML widget.

Which fields get prefilled on WooCommerce product pages?

termek (product name), cikkszam (SKU), kategoria, ar (price), termek_link, and for logged-in customers nev, email, telefon, ceg. Give your form fields these keys (field settings → key) to receive them.

Is the form GDPR compliant?

Data is stored by FormEmpire on EU servers (Germany). A data-processing agreement is available on request.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Description and settings text updated: online payment and invoicing are not available in FormEmpire yet, so they are no longer mentioned.

1.3.0

  • Block themes: the quote button is placed next to the Add to Cart block when the product template does not run the classic hooks; the order-received form works in the block Order Confirmation template (“Additional information” block).
  • The floating button’s script is enqueued through the WordPress script API.
  • Security: order data (name, e-mail, phone, items) is handed to the form only when WooCommerce itself shows the order – valid order key, logged-in customer or verified e-mail – never from the link alone; the page context is encoded safely for the script tag.

1.2.0

  • WooCommerce: a form on the order-received (thank-you) page with the order number, total, products, shipping and payment method handed over as hidden fields; the billing name, e-mail and phone prefilled for guests too.

1.1.0

  • Product context: price, unit, brand, image and link from the product page; HPOS compatibility declared.

1.0.0

  • First release: block, shortcode, floating button, WooCommerce quote button, optional API key for listing forms.
